messages.text: Hi, I wanted to buy the Hammer DC08 but I am also leaning toward the Kbox 22TH. I am blocked by the price point of the Kbox 22TH. Can you give me a significant rebate on this product? If yes, I’ll order one right away. Thank you (email hidden)

Handed to the team · discount request on a sales conversation, not mine to give

Florian, I can't put a discount on the KBOX myself, prices are as listed at $800. I've passed your request to Georges, who handles pricing. The team is offline right now and picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and his answer comes to your email, so you don't need to wait here.

Worth saying while you weigh them: they're not really competing. The D.08 at $539 is Scrypt, 480 MH/s for Doge and Litecoin, ~137W. The K. is Bitcoin, 22 TH/s at 330W. Which coin are you actually after?
The Hammer DC08 is also for BTC 12TH
Read the hammer miner dc08 page
Searched the catalog · Hammer BC08 Bitcoin 12TH

I just pulled the live DC08 listing to be sure. It's titled Hammer Miner DC08 (480MH/s), $539, algorithm SCRYPT for Litecoin and Doge, ~137W, ~50 dB. No Bitcoin hashrate on it, and there's no BC08 in our catalog.

If you want Bitcoin at that budget, the closest is the Thor P2, 10 TH/s at ~166W, ~40 dB, $369. The K. is 22 TH/s at 330W for $800, so it's the better value per TH.

Which coin are you really after, BTC or Doge?
BTC but I am sure the Hammer DC08 is BTC (Altair has it). If you give me a good rebate for the KBOX 22TH, I’ll move forward with you and this product. I’ll wait an answer in my email.

Understood, Florian. On our side the DC08 is the Scrypt unit, whatever another shop lists under that name, so for BTC it isn't the one.

The K. stays at $800 and a rebate isn't mine to give. Georges has your request with your email on it, he picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET and replies there, so you don't need to sit in the chat.

If you want it held in your name meanwhile, the page is heliumdeploy.com/products/gekkoscience-kbox-22-th-s. Anything else I can answer on the unit tonight?
All good, I’ll wait for an answer

Sounds good, Florian. Georges picks it up tomorrow from 10am ET and writes to (email hidden), and JD's dB numbers for the KBOX land in the same inbox.

A copy of this chat comes to that address once we're done here, and you can reply to it to reach us again. Talk soon.
